title: J5: MIMI topicId longer than 191 octets
description: JMAP ids cap at 255 bytes, so base64url of a MIMI topicId (up to 4096 octets) may not fit. Recommended: refuse or hash topicIds over 191 octets (choose one). PENDING Mark (from the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18); decide when mimid-1wgh.13 is planned.
